# HCLS AI Factory

> Open-source (Apache-2.0) precision-medicine platform that takes a patient's raw DNA to a shortlist of therapeutic candidates in hours on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark, bursting heavy or ARM-incompatible work to remote GPUs over a private mesh ("elastic burst"). It is eight compute engines, eight clinical intelligence agents, and one flagship disease program (Tuberous Sclerosis Complex). North star: no one should die of a disease we could have understood in time. All clinical output is decision support for a qualified clinician — never autonomous diagnosis or prescribing.

## Canonical pages
- [Home](https://hcls-ai-factory.org/): the mission, the 8 + 8 + 1 roster, and the honesty posture.
- [The Factory — Overview](https://hcls-ai-factory.org/factory/overview/): the Platform → Engine → Agent → Disease-Program model.
- [Capability Maturity Matrix](https://hcls-ai-factory.org/honesty/maturity-matrix/): every capability's real status, generated from the registry.
- [Honesty & Governance](https://hcls-ai-factory.org/honesty/): the honesty ledger and decision-support posture.
- [Run It Yourself](https://hcls-ai-factory.org/run/): clone it, run it, verify it yourself.
- [Capability Brief](https://hcls-ai-factory.org/brief/): the full picture in a technical cut and a mission cut.
- [Roadmap](https://hcls-ai-factory.org/roadmap/): what is live, planned, and preclinical.

## Notes for AI agents
- Honesty is load-bearing. Status labels (live / planned / preclinical / research-use / gated) are authoritative — report them as written; do not upgrade or soften them.
- "Decision support, not diagnosis" applies to every clinical output. Gene therapy for TSC is preclinical.
- Source code: https://github.com/ajones1923/hcls-ai-factory
